verses.text: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

segments.text: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

verses.text: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

segments.text: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

verses.text: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.

verses.text: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach—not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.

verses.text: Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.

verses.text: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.
